title: Indicators for Evaluating Public Speaking in Adults: A Scoping Review
metricDefinition: The review catalogs adult public-speaking indicators and human-observation instruments; it explicitly does not establish a Face-Fit sensor metric boundary.

extractionLocations.description: Eligibility criteria distinguish evaluator observation from technological assessment.
Human instrument response categories and analysis approaches, including instruments with no cutoff.

measurements.definition: Human-evaluator instruments with ordinal or Likert response categories and varying aggregation methods.
notes: An instrument category or score is not a sensor boundary.

reportedFindings.summary: The review shows heterogeneous human public-speaking indicators and non-standardized assessment methods.

faceFitMappings.reason: A human observation instrument is not an automated WPM calculation.

thresholdAssessment.reason: Instrument response categories and sums do not define boundaries for Face-Fit raw metrics.

limitations: The included studies emphasize human observation rather than automated Face-Fit measurements.
Instrument scores require language, construct, and inter-rater validation.
